Name: Partner Overhaul
Author: Jared
Description: Fixes a cluster of vanilla Partner (companion NPC) bugs: partners can now eat stew/broth, resume cleaning finished homes, stop over-watering capped garden plots, feed Pine Needles/Charcoal into a fireplace, and no longer have their action sounds heard across the map or their dialog interrupt an in-progress spirit-summon ritual. Also removes a stray 'Defecate' button from the Tree Top scenic event, and makes a Partner's Energy level ('Looks exhausted' / 'Looks tired' / 'Looks full of energy') visible on their card, which vanilla tracks but never shows the player. Ships opt-in diagnostics for a handful of still-unconfirmed bugs (fishing line, brain-tanning, clothes/temperature, cauldron ownership, pouch/acorn-flour stacking) plus a couple of small new QoL options (config-gated).
